name: B10-0326/2026 (Renew) – Deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of all political prisoners in Belarus, including Aliaksandra Pulinovich, a young woman jailed for 10 years and three months after a closed trial. It condemns the Lukashenka regime's repression, the abuse of anti-terrorism laws against minors, and the use of nuclear exercises with Russia. It asks the European Union to widen sanctions, support accountability cases abroad, and avoid normalising relations with the regime until prisoners are freed and legal reforms happen. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands the release of all political prisoners in Belarus, including Aliaksandra Pulinovich.
- It asks the European Union to widen sanctions on those responsible for repression and torture.
- It urges support for court cases abroad and no normalising of relations with the regime.
